items.title: Welcome channel
items.description: Where Blitz greets new members. Leave empty for no welcome messages.

items.title: Level-up channel
items.description: Where level-ups are announced. Leave empty to announce them where they happened.

items.title: Quote wall
items.description: Messages that get enough 🗣️ reactions are saved here. Leave empty to turn the quote wall off.

items.title: Birthday channel
items.description: Where Blitz wishes people happy birthday. Leave empty to turn birthdays off.

items.title: Staff log
items.description: Where Blitz notes auto-mod removals, joins and leaves. Leave empty for no log.

items.title: Private channels
items.description: Blitz stays out of these: no XP, no quotes, never shown in its domain or sent to its brain. Good for vent or staff channels.

items.title: Role for new members
items.description: Given to everyone who joins. Leave empty to give none.

items.title: Birthday role
items.description: Worn for the day on someone's birthday. Leave empty to give none.

items.title: Staff
items.description: Can use staff commands like !clear, !announce and !setxp. The owner, and roles that can manage the community, kick or ban, always can.

items.title: Turn off levels
items.description: Tick to stop Blitz handing out XP and level-ups. Levels are on while this is unticked.

items.title: Turn off auto-mod
items.description: Tick to stop Blitz removing floods, copy-paste spam and mass mentions. Auto-mod is on while this is unticked.

items.title: Reactions for the quote wall
items.description: How many 🗣️ reactions (not counting the author's) save a message to the quote wall.

items.title: Anthropic API key
items.description: Lets Blitz understand and answer messages with Claude. Create a key at console.anthropic.com. Messages that mention Blitz, plus the last few messages in that channel, are sent to Anthropic's API (never from the vent). Leave empty to keep Blitz on simple keyword reactions.

items.title: About this community
items.description: Optional. A sentence or two for Blitz's brain: what the community is about, its vibe, in-jokes. Only used with an API key.
